notes.title: Update Notes 24 Feb
notes.notes:
New capture options:

 Device selection
 Activation Modes:
Push-To-Talk Activates the microphone only when a designated key or button is pressed, ensuring that only intentional speech is transmitted while minimizing background noise and unintended audio capture.
Responsive Toggle Automatically mutes the microphone while the bot is speaking, then unmutes once the response is complete, preventing audio feedback and ensuring clear communication.
Voice Sense Voice activation for settings where game audio isn’t captured by the microphone.
 Recognition Delay The interval between when speech is recognized and when the corresponding text is sent to the chat. Lower delay values are ideal for fast speakers, while higher values are recommended for users who naturally pause during their speech.
 Configurable PPT/Interrupt Hotkey A customizable key or button that activates push-to-talk and instantly interrupts bot responses, ensuring user commands always take precedence.
